DeepMind, Microsoft, xAI added May 2026; 40+ evaluations; TRAINS taskforce; 2025 refocus. Cited from a search snippet; not re-fetched in full.

Signals citing this source

  • US CAISI (NIST), F (for): Public funding; formal access agreements with five developers.
  • US CAISI (NIST), A (for): More than 40 evaluations including unreleased models; classified CBRN and cyber work via the TRAINS taskforce.
  • US CAISI (NIST), G (against): Refocused in 2025 from broad safety research to demonstrable national-security risks; mandate is politically steerable.
  • US CAISI (NIST), R (against): Publishes little per model; findings mostly stay inside government.
  • Microsoft AI Red Team, F (against): Microsoft is a major OpenAI investor and a frontier developer with its own CAISI agreement.
